scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:prod-like: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:web:prod-like" "npm run dev:server:prod-like"
scripts.dev:otp: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:web:prod-like" "npm run dev:server:prod-like"
scripts.dev:server: export PATH="$PATH:/c/xampp/php" && php backend/composer.phar install --no-interaction --quiet -d backend 2>/dev/null; php -d upload_max_filesize=8M -d post_max_size=16M -S 127.0.0.1:8000 start.php
scripts.dev:server:prod-like: export PATH="$PATH:/c/xampp/php" && php backend/composer.phar install --no-interaction --quiet -d backend 2>/dev/null; SKIP_EMAIL_VERIFY=false SKIP_PHONE_VERIFY=false MSG91_OTP_MODE=production php -d upload_max_filesize=8M -d post_max_size=16M -S 127.0.0.1:8000 start.php
